prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated pixel art world marker for a top-down zombie survival game, 64 pixels per world unit. A weathered green metal road sign on TWO short dark rusted metal posts, board facing viewer squarely, slight top surface visible matching top-down orthographic 2D street art. Bold exceptionally readable cream block lettering EXACTLY "START" (S T A R T), a small upward arrow below. Torn yellow caution ribbon attached to one post. Scuffed green paint, metal rivets, small warm orange reflector. Quiet clear silhouette, hand placed crunchy pixel clusters, muted olive and dirty cream palette. Single whole object centered on a pure uniform #FF00FF magenta background, no ground plane, no floor square, no cast shadow, no checkerboard, no surrounding scene, no other text. 1024x1024 output, object has comfortable margin all around, finished sprite will be reduced to96x128 pixels; make the letter strokes thick and legible at that size. Match grim detailed pixel streets, not cartoon vector, not photoreal photograph, no glow haze.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated building sprite for an abandoned zombie street, used to mark the EXIT SAFE SHELTER. A compact reinforced urban concrete shelter fortress: weathered flat roof with steel edging, thick concrete front wall, central heavy reinforced CLOSED steel doorway with warm green safe-zone lamps on both sides, muted green shield emblem above door, sandbag reinforcement to left/right edges, boarded narrow windows, small roof ventilation and antenna. Friendly refuge amidst apocalypse, solid grounded building, believable roof and facade depth but FRONT-FACING three-quarter top-down ORTHOGRAPHIC projection. Perfectly horizontal roof and front base, nearly NO side facade, not an isometric diamond. Entrance center clearly readable, doorway adult-human scale relative to existing compact 4x3-unit houses. Detailed restrained pixel art, 64px-per-unit pixel density; finished sprite256x192pixels, muted charcoal concrete, olive metal, warm pale green lamps, subtle rusty ochre accents. Exterior footprint rectangular, lower facade stands on baseline, NO big ground shadow below, no pavement block, no floating base. Whole building isolated with clear outer margins on pure flat bright #FF00FF magenta, no magenta inside building, no texture on background, NO text/lettering/numbers/logos/watermarks. Canvas1024x1024.

Production sprite sheet for a 2D top-down zombie survival roguelike. Muted detailed pixel art with crisp single-pixel clusters, grim abandoned urban atmosphere. Orthographic three-quarter top-down camera showing face and top of head, NOT isometric and NOT perspective. No weapons, no boss armor, ordinary human sized zombie, readable slender silhouette. Entire canvas EXACTLY 1024x1024, EXACT 8 columns by 8 rows, each cell EXACTLY128x128. Cell centers at x=64,192,320,448,576,704,832,960 and y=64,192,320,448,576,704,832,960. Every cell contains ONE complete independent figure with feet on same baseline y=116 within its cell, centered at x=64; head around y=24; margin clear; NO clipping, NO overlaps, NO dividers, NO gridlines, NO labels, NO lettering. Pure flat bright magenta #FF00FF background everywhere outside sprites, NOT checkerboard. No magenta within character; no shadows or ground under feet. Consistent character scale, outfit, face, limb lengths and lighting in ALL frames.
Rows from TOP to BOTTOM:
1 WALK DOWN towards viewer, 8 equally spaced phases of complete seamless two-leg gait.
2 WALK UP away from viewer, back of head/back visible, same 8 gait phases.
3 WALK RIGHT, strict right-facing profile, nose and toes point right, same 8 gait phases.
4 ATTACK DOWN: 8 frames anticipation, draw-back, wind-up, forward swipe frame3, maximum reach frame4, follow-through, recoil, recover. Distinct arms, body and posture, legs remain grounded.
5 ATTACK UP: 8 matching timing frames facing away, arm strike forward away from camera.
6 ATTACK RIGHT: 8 matching timing frames, swing right, clear full extension and return.
7 DEATH DOWN: 8 distinct progressive frames: standing hit, stagger, bent knees, knees buckle, falling, on ground, fully prone, settled corpse; no gore.
8 IDLE: columns1-4 face DOWN four gentle breathing frames, columns5-6 face UP gentle breathing, columns7-8 face RIGHT gentle breathing.
Walk phase progression 0 left foot leading right trailing;1 passing;2 feet together torso highest;3 right foot stepping;4 right foot leading left trailing;5 passing;6 feet together torso highest;7 left foot stepping returns smoothly to phase0. Show REAL alternating legs and counter-swing arms, not the same pose in all cells. Feet fixed baseline except natural +/-2 pixels bounce. Front and back show two visibly separate legs. Side gait has distinctly separated leading/trailing feet. All faces DOWN or UP or RIGHT as specified; never diagonal. NO contact sheets of unrelated characters.
Character identity to maintain: ordinary male infected maintenance worker, pale gray-green skin, short dark receding hair, dirty faded ORANGE reflective safety vest over dark olive long-sleeve shirt, dark charcoal work trousers, worn brown work boots, no helmet, no weapon. Slim human build like existing first ordinary zombie, torn hems and asymmetrical limp. Gait is hunched forward with left shoulder lower, slow dragging left foot between alternating strides; right arm reaches slightly farther than left. ATTACK is two-handed downward clawing shove, visible shoulder wind-up. Death falls forward onto side. NOT muscular elite, NOT giant.
